findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_snippets" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "account" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tip, find_snippets, check_installed · Private data: find_snippets, check_installed · Public sink: get_tip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tip, find_snippets, check_installed · Private data: find_snippets, check_installed · Public sink: get_tip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
